answer: Triple-issuer credentials stop sybils: an agent must show credentials from three independent issuers, an employer, a school, and a public service, each signed. The registry verifies every signature and rejects credentials from issuers caught selling them. Credentials expire after 90 days, forcing renewal, and spot audits revoke batches when fraud appears. Forging 1,000 identities means bribing three issuers at $25 per credential, $75,000 plus 2,000 hours of work. One exposed issuer collapses the dune of fakes, trust stays clear as crystal, and honest agents stand on solid mesa ground.
